paperl10n-empty-state: Open a project folder to see what there is to translate.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-missing: This folder has no paperl10n.config.json yet.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-unreada: The config file $1 can't be read ($2).
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-docume: The config names the format "$1", which isn't installed.
paperl10n-error-workspace-no-document-fo: No installed format recognizes this project. Name one in the config file with "documentFormat".
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-projec: That project isn't open anymore. Open it again.
paperl10n-error-internal-unexpected: Something went wrong inside Paper Lion. Please report it.
paperl10n-error-internal-invalid-request: Paper Lion received a request it can't handle. Please report it.
paperl10n-welcome-title: Translate your docs, side by side
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-docume: The page "$1" isn't in this project anymore. Open the project again to refresh the list.
paperl10n-error-workspace-no-target-loca: Choose the language to translate into first.
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-langua: Paper Lion doesn't know the language "$1". To use it, define it under "languages" in paperl10n.config.json.
paperl10n-error-workspace-target-is-sour: "$1" is this project's source language, so the translation can't be in it too.
paperl10n-needs-target: Choose the language to translate this project into. Paper Lion saves it in paperl10n.config.json, so everyone working on the project shares it.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-unwrita: The config file $1 can't be saved ($2).
paperl10n-language-search-placeholder: Name or code, in any language
paperl10n-no-matching-languages: No language matches "$1". To use a language Paper Lion doesn't know, define it under "languages" in paperl10n.config.json.
paperl10n-error-workspace-document-chang: $1 changed on disk since you started editing it, so it wasn't overwritten.
paperl10n-new-translation: A copy of the source. Translate it, then save to create $1.
paperl10n-unsaved-message: Your changes to the translation of $1 aren't saved yet.
paperl10n-error-workspace-draft-unwritab: Your unsaved changes couldn't be kept as a draft. They're still here: save them to keep them.
paperl10n-draft-restored: Unsaved changes from your last session were restored.
paperl10n-draft-restored-changed: Unsaved changes from your last session were restored. The file has changed on disk since, so saving will ask which version to keep.
paperl10n-conflict-message: $1 was changed outside Paper Lion (by git or another editor, for example) since you started editing it. Your changes aren't saved yet. Reload the file to drop them, or overwrite the file with your version.
paperl10n-sections-unpaired-count: This page shows in full: its sections don't line up with the source's ($1 in the translation, $2 in the source). When they match, it opens section by section.
paperl10n-sections-unpaired-level: This page shows in full: the translation's headings are at a different level from the source's. When they match, it opens section by section.
paperl10n-sections-changed: The sections have changed since this page opened. They'll be paired again when you reopen it.
